blocks.text: i. Jab kisi rigid body (aisi body jo shakal nahi badalti) par force F⃗ aise point par lagti hai jis ka position vector, ghoomne wali axis ke kisi point se, r⃗ hai, to force ka turning effect (ghumane wala asar), yani torque τ, r⃗ aur F⃗ ka vector product hai:
ii. Magnetic field B⃗ mein charge q aur velocity v⃗ wale particle (zarre) par force F⃗, v⃗ aur B⃗ ke vector product se milti hai:

blocks.caption: Dono products ka comparison (muqabla)
rows: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂
A⃗ aur B⃗ ke plane par perpendicular vector (right hand rule)
torque τ⃗ = r⃗ × F⃗; F⃗ = q(v⃗ × B⃗)

blocks.prompt: Do vectors ke cross product aur scalar product ki magnitudes 4√3 aur 4 hain. Un ke darmiyan angle nikalein. Yeh bhi batayein ke dot product kab sab se zyada hota hai aur cross product kab.
blocks.explanation: AB sin θ = 4√3 aur AB cos θ = 4. Pehli ko doosri se divide karein: tan θ = √3, is liye θ = 60°. Dot product parallel vectors ke liye sab se zyada hai (cos θ = 1) aur cross product perpendicular vectors ke liye (sin θ = 1).

items: Dot product: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos θ = A × (A⃗ par B⃗ ka projection) = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz; commutative; perpendicular ke liye 0, parallel ke liye AB, khud se A²; work = F⃗.d⃗.

Cross product: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂, right hand rule se plane par perpendicular; A⃗ × B⃗ = -B⃗ × A⃗; perpendicular ke liye maximum, parallel ke liye null; magnitude = parallelogram ka area; torque r⃗ × F⃗, force q(v⃗ × B⃗).
